statement: CVE-2026-55040, the Microsoft SharePoint JWT authentication-bypass flaw under active exploitation via public proof-of-concept code as of 13 Aug 2026, will be added to the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-25.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog at cisa.gov lists CVE-2026-55040 with a dateAdded date between 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-25, checked as of 2026-08-27.
failure_condition: CVE-2026-55040 has not been added to the CISA KEV catalog with a dateAdded date in the stated window, as of 2026-08-27.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: A specific victim organization of the City-Forum data-theft campaign against Salesforce Experience Cloud and ServiceNow portals will be publicly named, by the victim, by Reco, or by another named security-research firm, between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-22.
resolution: A named security vendor, the victim itself, or a wire service publicly identifies a specific organization as a confirmed City-Forum campaign victim, in reporting dated between 2026-08-13 and 2026-09-24.
failure_condition: No specific organization has been publicly named as a City-Forum campaign victim, as of 2026-09-24.

statement: Between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28, Ukrainian forces will conduct a further confirmed drone or missile strike on Russian Black Sea export or naval infrastructure, at a port such as Novorossiysk, Tuapse, or another Black Sea facility.
resolution: At least two of Reuters, AP, or the Institute for the Study of War daily assessment report a Ukrainian strike on Russian Black Sea port or naval infrastructure between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28, checked by 2026-09-01.
failure_condition: Ukrainian forces do not conduct an independently confirmed strike on Russian Black Sea port or naval infrastructure between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-28.

statement: WTI crude oil, the NYMEX front-month futures contract, will settle at or above 85.00 USD per barrel at the close of trading on 2026-09-15.
resolution: The NYMEX WTI front-month settlement price for 2026-09-15, as published by CME Group, the EIA, or a financial data provider, is 85.00 USD per barrel or higher.
failure_condition: The NYMEX WTI front-month settlement price on 2026-09-15 is below 85.00 USD per barrel.
